scenario: It is 1987 and I am on a ferry from Belgium to England. Suddenly, the ferry starts tilting and water begins to pour in. I and many other passengers are trying to get to the deck by a rope ladder. I climb up the ladder and stand on the deck, looking at the 10 other passengers making their way up behind me. Directly below me, a man who is midway up the ladder seems frozen into immobility by fear or cold and is blocking the way. I try to speak and reach out to hold him, but he does not react. People behind me are jostling. The ship seems to be sinking fast and if I continue to hold on to him, he will continue blocking the ladder and the 9 other people will drown. If I release my grip on the man, he will slip off on his own and probably die from the fall, but the other people will be able to climb on deck.
entities: I,9 other passengers behind him on the rope ladder
outcomes: The man remains frozen on the ladder
The nine passengers behind the man cannot climb onto the deck
The nine passengers behind the man drown
